faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Co-op City?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Can wasps and hornets enter high-rise apartments in Co-op City?
faqs.answer: Yes, wasps and yellow jackets commonly enter high-rise units through balconies, open windows, ventilation systems, and exterior wall cracks. Co-op City's buildings are particularly susceptible due to aging infrastructure and abundant nearby vegetation. Our technicians are experienced in navigating multi-story buildings and can access any floor safely to treat nests in wall voids, soffits, and other concealed spaces.
